title: The Willingdon Tote | Hand-Woven Grass Bag | Grasscrafts
descriptionHtml:
The Willingdon Tote | Hand-Woven Sabai Grass

True luxury isn't about being noticed; it's about being understood. The Willingdon Tote is a tribute to the slow-made movement — hand-woven from sustainably harvested Sabai grass by master artisans who have spent lifetimes perfecting their craft.

The Sabai Grass Story

Sabai grass grows wild in the forests of Odisha and Jharkhand, harvested by tribal communities who have woven it for generations. Each strand is hand-twisted and woven into a structure that is both remarkably strong and beautifully textured.

Designed for the Discerning Woman

Structured, spacious, and effortlessly elegant — the Willingdon Tote moves from morning meetings to weekend markets without missing a beat. Its natural earthy tones complement linen, silk, and everything in between.

Perfect For

Work, travel, gifting, and the woman who values meaning over mass production.

Material & Care

100% natural Sabai grass. Avoid prolonged moisture. Store in a cool, dry place. Wipe clean with a dry cloth.
